assets.name: champagne-artwork
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a genuinely transparent PNG illustration asset. Match ONLY panel 04 Cherry Tower at bottom left of supplied approved moodboard: SIX cherry red champagne coupes forming a clear 1-2-3 tower, long raspberry stems, opaque cream rims and drink, alternating irregular cream dots and vertical printed hatch patterns. A small dark cherry red champagne bottle standing slightly tilted to the RIGHT of the tower, pink speckled foil and pink label with two simple red cherries; a small mustard cork popping above it, sparse navy dots and ivory bubble confetti. Exactly six coupes, all bowls and stems fully visible. Match the approved retro gouache / textured painted-paper collage with intentionally naive shapes, tactile coarse pigment grain, flat colors and rough charming edges. Compact square-ish composition with small comfortable margin; all background outside objects genuinely transparent. NO pink background, no text or lettering anywhere, no logos, no shadows, no 3D, no shiny glass or realistic watercolor. Preserve cream dots, drinks and bubbles opaque.
